# Summary

**Scope.** This document summarizes the pilot[^pilot] for research-idea card[^card] [FILL: ID] ("[FILL: card title]"): what the idea is, how the pilot was run, what it found, the full draft project spec, and the decisions made along the way. **Status.** In `research-ideas.md` the card is marked `[FILL: piloted-pass or piloted-fail]`[^pf] [FILL: one or two sentences on why. If the spec is for a re-scoped card, say so and add the conditional draft[^cond] footnote reference; otherwise delete the [^cond] definition use.]
